correctness.rationale: For every connected simple graph of order at least two, inner orbits are the vertical pairs, yielding a necessary and sufficient fiber-map representation. Exact independent exhaustive computations confirm small finite cases, without constituting the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Determines all retraction image-cardinality coefficients of an infinite graph-indexed family of quandles. The two natural graph invariants have distinct multiplicative/additive roles, and the rank polynomial recovers each independent-set coefficient whenever the graph has no false twins. This motivated reconstruction property makes the exact census mathematically useful, rather than an arbitrary finite count.
